sentences.japanese: 空が海と一つに溶け込むように見えた。
sentences.english: The sky seemed to blend with the sea.

sentences.japanese: 海は水平線で空に溶け込んでいた。
sentences.english: The ocean melted into the sky on the horizon.

sentences.japanese: 海と空の色がお互いに溶け合っている。
sentences.english: The colors of the sea and the sky blend into one another.

sentences.japanese: 家族はまもなく新しい環境に溶け込んだ。
sentences.english: The family assimilated quickly into their new environment.

sentences.japanese: ろうそくの両端を燃やすことは、極めて簡単にろうそくを溶かすことになる - 美女を両脇に抱え込んだプレイボーイのように。
sentences.english: Burning the candle at both ends reduces the candle to wax in a hurry - just like a playboy having a pretty girl on each arm.
